`pjrt_c_api.h` is copied without modification from OpenXLA XLA revision
`fc840b37e26bd36c99f32e295324a1700dc12ecd` (C API 0.116), matching the
compiler integration's XLA pin. It is licensed under Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE`.

Source: https://github.com/openxla/xla/blob/fc840b37e26bd36c99f32e295324a1700dc12ecd/xla/pjrt/c/pjrt_c_api.h

Bindings are generated by bindgen for the Cargo target. No XLA source checkout,
C++ libraries, or matching LLVM version is needed to build this crate; the build
requires libclang. Callers must check the plugin's API version and table size
before accessing fields, and follow the upstream ownership contracts.
